items.title: OneMain Financial Gets FDIC Approval to Launch a Bank
items.why: A consumer lender gaining a bank charter could sharpen its pricing and deposit-funded lending, adding competitive pressure.
items.summary_ai: OneMain Financial received FDIC approval to set up its own bank, which could let it fund lending with deposits.
items.take: A consumer lender gaining a bank charter could sharpen its pricing and deposit-funded lending, adding competitive pressure.
